newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Peregrine rises after interim earnings.
newsitem.headline: Peregrine rises after interim earnings.

text.p: Shares in Peregrine Investments Holdings Ltd rose Thursday afternoon after the company reported a 15 percent rise in interim net profit.
"Institutional buying was seen after the encouraging results, which were on the high end of expectations," said a dealing manager at a regional brokerage.

Brokers said anticipation of stronger earnings growth in second half in view of more volatile stock market also aided demand. The shares rose HK$0.35 or 3.02 percent to hit an intraday high of HK$11.95 ahead of the close on volume of 2.37 million shares. -- Hong Kong Newsroom (852) 2843 6370
